rationale: User-selected BFF-focused effort chosen as an architecture-pattern adherence testbed for a future, separately authorized execution. Explicit human selection supplies the parking-promotion authority; the effort has no unresolved hard dependency (epic membership is a soft pointer: theme-epic members drain as standalone workstreams).
rollback_boundary: Remove only newly created MI-003 Level 3 paths on execution failure; return/cancel transitions disable the target route while preserving the source tuple and all immutable target revisions; reactivation requires a new explicit selection revision.
selection_method: Explicit human message naming the unique stable source-local identity of one presented eligible candidate tuple after candidate review; the executor verified an exact single match of the full tuple (source path, identity, revision, SHA-256) against the candidate projection and recomputed the source digest live at the pinned revision.
